dataset: Public-LP technology and AI-adjacent private-capital realization cohort
source: California State Teachers Retirement System Private Equity Portfolio Performance
selection_method: Curated technology-specialist and technology-heavy venture/growth fund families with vintages 2012 or later and positive paid-in capital.
important_limitations: This is a public-LP cohort, not a complete private-market census.
Fund-level results are not attributable solely to AI investments.
Headline realization metrics use vintages at least five years old as of the source date.
CalSTRS notes that valuation and IRR methodologies can differ and interim IRRs are not final until liquidation.

metric_definitions.RVPI: Remaining NAV divided by paid-in capital.
metric_definitions.Realized Share: Distributions divided by distributions plus NAV.
